Overview of the Role

As a Standards and Compliance Auditor, you will provide specialized auditing services to internationally recognized organizations, ensuring adherence to stringent industry standards. Initially, you will work as part of the auditing team, with the expectation of progressing to Lead Auditor following a comprehensive familiarization and training period. This high‑profile role requires direct engagement with industry experts and the coordination of audits for participating companies worldwide. Audits typically range from 3–5 days and encompass a diverse set of subjects reviewed against defined international standards. At the conclusion of each audit, you will deliver both a verbal presentation of findings and a detailed written report outlining audit results, areas of compliance, and recommendations for improvement. This position offers the opportunity for extensive international experience, with global travel typically in business class and four‑star accommodation provided.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive audits in line with international standards, industry regulations, and company policies.
  • Engage directly with industry stakeholders to assess and verify compliance within relevant frameworks.
  • Prepare and deliver detailed audit reports, including executive summaries and risk assessments, and present findings professionally in both written and verbal formats.
  • Coordinate with international teams and organizations to schedule and execute audits efficiently.
  • Ensure audits are conducted within established timeframes and deliverables are met.
  • Provide actionable recommendations to clients on areas for improvement and compliance enhancements.
  • Stay updated on the latest compliance regulations, security standards, and industry best practices.
  • Work collaboratively within a team while also demonstrating the ability to lead and manage audit projects.

What You’ll Bring

The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and methodical professional with expertise in auditing management systems based on international standards. Experience within the telecommunications industry, manufacturing processes, or information security audits will be considered an advantage.

  • Candidates must have work authorization in the country for which they are applying, without employer‑provided visa sponsorship.

Overview

Who We Are: TELUS Digital is an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers. From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

Our Senior Accountant, Tax & Compliance is an integral part of our Finance team at TELUS Digital. This role will have the option to be in a Work From Near (Hybrid) capacity based out of one of the following offices: Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, or Boston, MA, OR in a Work From Anywhere (Remote) capacity from within the U.S.

The Opportunity

As TELUS Digital’s Senior Accountant, Tax & Compliance, you’ll lead tax compliance efforts for our nationwide operations, collaborating with the Account & Consolidation Manager. You’ll lead the preparation and filing of indirect taxes, resolving tax notices, and partnering with external consultants. Additionally, you’ll handle the business insurance, coordinate Workers’ Compensation compliance, and contribute to month-end close activities. Your expertise will be pivotal in maintaining compliance, organizing meticulous filing systems, and supporting various financial processes, making you a key figure in TELUS Digital’s financial integrity.

  • Lead the preparation of multi-state sales and use tax returns
  • Ownership for quarterly filing for the Ohio Commercial Activity Tax (CAT) and Washington Business and Occupation (B&O) tax
  • Resolve tax notices by communicating with the payroll team as needed
  • Determine the course of action for any tax notices received, including submission/follow-ups with external vendor partners
  • File property tax filings for VA and NC
  • Collaborate with external tax accounting vendors and our parent company for various types of filings, including state and federal income tax filings
  • Involved in the month-end close activities, including reconciling certain accounts, including sales tax payable, and recording certain reclassifications
  • Ownership of business insurance, disbursement and submission of renewed Certificate of insurance to clients, and submission of needed documentation for Workers’ Compensation compliance and annual audits
  • Prepare payments and remittances for payments due, including mail tracking, documentation, etc.
  • Maintain the filling system for all entities in the WillowTree enterprise
  • Partner with Corporation Service Company (CSC) for any requirements related to annual reporting
  • Partner with WillowTree’s Accounts Payable team for 1099 filing and submission
  • Review of expense reports and record month-end accruals relating to expense reporting
  • Assist with audit preparation related to the financial statement audit

Qualifications/Skills

  • 3+ years of tax accounting experience
  • Extremely detail-oriented
  • Track record of striving for data integrity and a desire to constantly improve the efficiency and effectiveness of accounting processes
  • Experience with regulatory filings
  • Strong understanding of taxes, sales and use tax, and general compliance
  • Ability to work independently without considerable oversight and to act decisively in order to meet deadlines and maintain accuracy
  • Maintains a consistent awareness of tax accounting trends and changes
  • Collaborative approach with the ability to engage various disciplines and stakeholders in an organization
  • Demonstrates an equitable and open-minded approach when considering the viewpoints of others, especially when those viewpoints differ from their own
  • Strong Excel and/or Google Sheet skills

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Workday
  • Understanding of SOX compliance
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration with an Accounting emphasis, or a CPA

  • end all nuclear threats
